```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Get all files in gallery/images relative to this document
files <- list.files("images", full.names = TRUE)

# Filter to common image types (adjust as needed)
image_ext <- c(".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".webp", ".svg")
imgs <- files[tolower(tools::file_ext(files)) %in% sub("^\\.", "", image_ext)]

# Emit HTML for a simple responsive gallery
cat("<div class='image-gallery'>\n")
for (img in imgs) {
  # Make path relative to this qmd for the browser
  rel <- gsub("^images/", "images/", img)
  cat(sprintf("  <figure class='gallery-item'>\n    <img src='%s' loading='lazy'/></figure>\n", rel))
}
cat("</div>\n")
```
